bank_metadata.originality_statement: Questions are independently authored and use familiar interview algorithm patterns without copying LeetCode problem statements verbatim. No exhaustive similarity scan against every published problem has been performed.
notes: All strings use the character model stated in each question; ASCII-only assumptions are explicitly noted where relevant.
Expected outputs are provided for every example and edge case.
The complexity fields describe a target efficient approach, not mandatory implementation details.
